lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This is the Atlantic Beverage and Bottling site walkthrough, recorded for the buyer's site visit file.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: We're entering through the main receiving dock on the east side of the building. Sixty-two thousand square feet under roof, all of it on one level.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This is filling line one. Twelve ounce aluminium, rated at four hundred cans a minute, and it's running product for a customer we've had nine years.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Line two. This is the rebuild we completed in twenty twenty-four. New filler, new capper, roughly eight hundred thousand dollars, and you'll find it on the fixed asset register at cost.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Line three handles our bottle formats. Across all three lines we're running at about seventy-two percent of rated capacity, so there is real headroom here without new steel.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Warehouse and finished goods. Racking is to current code, and we passed our last third party food safety audit with no major findings.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's the floor. Forty-one people, no recordable safety incidents in the last three years, and no deferred maintenance items outstanding.
